thread:
marta: Heads up — plan to lift the runtime pin for quant-v5 on Tue 2026-03-16 22:00 UTC. Staggered rollout: 5% -> 30% -> 100%. Exemptions for longseq/embeddings-heavy models. Need SDK shim check + QA signoff. Assigning canary in us-west-2.

sam: I'll add a deploy job and schedule. Any objections? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Scheduled: runtime-unpin-quant-v5 at 2026-03-16T22:00:00Z. Canary group: 'canary-quant-v5-usw2'. Rollout steps: 5%, 30%, 100%. Auto-rollback on 5m error-rate spike > 3x baseline.

jacob: SDK shim v1.7.4 contains the compatibility fix for kv-cache handling. Recommend we bake that into the canary image before unpin. I can push a hotfix tag by EOD.

priya: Can we get a preflight test matrix? I'll run perf + regression on the canary. Test IDs I'll use: perf-quantv5-01, regen-compat-02. Need the canary image tag.

nik: Exit criteria: all traces green for 30m at each stage, no sustained error-rate > 1.5x baseline, tail latency under 99p thresholds. Rollback plan: immediate revert to runtime-pin-3a and block traffic to the canary. Sam, ensure traffic cutoff script and runbook are ready.

sam: Cutoff script is ready. Command to run if rollback needed:
```
./scripts/cut_traffic.sh --group canary-quant-v5-usw2 --mode drain
```
Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-unpin (internal).

marta: QA — please post the canary report back in this thread. Devs — tag any models that should be exempt (longseq / embeddings heavy).

priya: Will post the report. Quick note: embeddings-prod-nyc uses longseq fallback; recommend exemption for model id "rw-emb-longseq-v2".

jacob: Acknowledged. I'll add rw-emb-longseq-v2 to the exempt list and update routing rules:
```
if model_id in ['rw-emb-longseq-v2']:
    route -> runtime-pin-3a
```

sam: Deployment checklist done. deploy-bot will post updates during rollout and will auto-rollback based on alerts.

deploy-bot: Note: starting canary at 2026-03-16T22:00:00Z -> 5% traffic. Monitoring endpoints: /metrics/runtime_errors, /metrics/latency. Alerts will post to #incidents on breach.

marta: :thumbsup: locking schedule. If no blockers by EOD, we proceed.
